hero.intro: I’m Jad Elahmad. My experience spans IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, business systems, and project delivery. I work across technical and business teams to turn complex initiatives into practical outcomes.

about.lead: I've built my career across technology, operations, and project delivery.
about.paragraph1: I've worked with technical teams and business leaders to improve systems, processes, and the way organizations operate. My experience includes infrastructure modernization, cybersecurity, IT service management, and business systems.
about.paragraph2: That background helps me understand technical details while keeping sight of the planning, communication, and decisions needed to deliver. I enjoy solving practical problems and working with people who bring different perspectives.

speaking.intro: I’ve had the opportunity to speak at PASS Data Community Summit in 2022, 2023, and 2024. I value exchanging perspectives, learning from others, and contributing to conversations across the technology community.

personal.paragraph1: Outside of work, I’m drawn to challenges that push my limits. From training for my fourth marathon to completing a 100+ mile cycling event in under six hours and tackling demanding hikes across the U.S. with my wife, I enjoy setting ambitious goals and putting in the work to reach them.
personal.paragraph2: The preparation is part of what makes each challenge worthwhile.
